name: Neon backstreet
desc: A cramped after-dark side street where deals, chases and confessions happen one turn off the main road.
tags: narrow back alley, neon signs, glowing shop signage, wet asphalt, puddle reflections, air conditioning units, tangled overhead cables, vending machine, stacked crates, fire escape, steam from a vent
prose: a narrow back street at night, its walls crowded with neon signs and tangled cables, a vending machine glowing beside stacked crates and steam rising from a vent over wet asphalt that throws the light back
note: The neon is the light source, so the grade must not fight it - a heavy night pass flattens the signs into orange mush. Keep the wet ground tags; without puddle reflections the street reads as a flat corridor and the signs stop lighting anything. The neon look is the only preset that raises saturation, so do not stack it with anything else hot. If the signage language matters, say so, or you get generic glowing characters.
